info.title: Social0 API
info.summary: Publish and schedule social posts across 9 networks
info.description:
Programmatic access to Social0 publishing. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_...` (API key) or OAuth 2.0 (MCP connector).

## Versioning
The public API is versioned in the URL (`/v1`). Additive changes may ship in v1. Breaking changes get a new prefix or a Sunset window. Policy: https://social0.app/api-versioning.md

Deprecated operations are marked `deprecated: true` in this spec and return `Deprecation: true`. When a removal date is known, responses include `Sunset`.

## Rate limits
Responses include `RateLimit`, `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining`, `RateLimit-Reset`, and `RateLimit-Policy`. 429 responses also include `Retry-After`.

Free 60/hour, Starter 300, Growth 1000, Pro 5000, Max 10000.

## Async publish
`POST /v1/posts/publish` and `POST /v1/posts/{id}/publish` return `202 Accepted` with `Location: /v1/jobs/{tracking_id}` and a `tracking_id` in the body. Poll `GET /v1/jobs/{tracking_id}` until `completed`, `failed`, or `partial`.

## Examples

### cURL - list accounts
```bash
curl https://api.social0.app/v1/accounts \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_YOUR_KEY"
```

### JavaScript - create and publish
```javascript
const res = await fetch('https://api.social0.app/v1/posts/publish', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': 'Bearer sk_live_YOUR_KEY',
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'Idempotency-Key': crypto.randomUUID(),
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    content: 'Hello from the API!',
    platforms: ['account-uuid-here'],
  }),
});
const { tracking_id } = await res.json();
```

## Errors
Every 4xx and 5xx response uses a typed error object `{ "error": { "code": string, "message": string, "details"?: object } }`. The same payload is also documented as RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` (`type`, `title`, `status`, `detail`). 401 responses include `WWW-Authenticate`. 429 responses include `Retry-After`.

bearerAuth.description: Social0 API key (`sk_live_...`). Keys currently have full account access; prefer OAuth scopes when using MCP.

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.0 authorization code + PKCE used by the hosted MCP connector. Request the narrowest scopes you need.

scopes.me:read: Read the authenticated user profile and plan.
scopes.accounts:write: Start OAuth connect and disconnect social accounts.
scopes.posts:read: List and get posts and publication events.
scopes.posts:write: Create, update, delete, schedule, and publish posts.
scopes.media:write: Presign, confirm, and read media uploads.
scopes.jobs:read: Read publish job status and event streams.
scopes.webhooks:write: Create, update, and delete webhook subscriptions.

Location.description: URL to poll for an async job

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-supplied key so retries do not double-publish.

Fresh.name: fresh
Fresh.description: Bypass warm cache and hit the platform APIs. Entries younger than 90s are still served from cache to protect shared platform quotas.

last_delivery_at.description: When Social0 last attempted a delivery to this endpoint. Null means nothing has been attempted yet.

last_delivery_response_status.description: HTTP status the endpoint returned on the last attempt, or null if it never responded.

WebhookDelivery.description: One delivery attempt group. Retries of the same event collapse into a single record; `attempts` says how many requests were made.

delivery_id.description: Payload `id`, sent to the endpoint as X-Social0-Delivery-Id.

status.description: `blocked` means Social0 never sent the request — the URL is not a public address, or the signing secret could not be read.

next_before.description: Pass as `before` to fetch the next page; null when the page was not full.

MetricSet.description: Metric values the platform actually reported. `null` means the network does not expose that metric for this post.

engagement.description: likes + comments + shares + reposts + quotes + saves + clicks

missing_scopes.description: OAuth scopes the account still needs for this feature. The marker `token_expired` means the stored token itself was revoked or expired; reconnect the account either way.
OAuth scopes the account still needs for this feature. The marker `token_expired` means the stored token itself was revoked or expired; reconnect the account either way.
Scopes missing on the publishing account, or the marker `token_expired` when its token was revoked or expired. Reconnect either way.

sampled.description: True when only the most recent `sample_limit` publications were read.

partial.description: True when the live request budget expired before every publication was read.

publication_id.description: Required when replying to, liking, or hiding this comment.

answered.description: True when the connected account already replied in this thread.

next_before.description: Pass as `before` to page older publications.

Error.description: Typed error with machine-readable code and human-readable message

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid API key / OAuth token

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Return deliveries created strictly before this timestamp.

post.description: Sends a signed `webhook.test` event to the endpoint now, regardless of its event filter, and returns what the endpoint answered. Subject to the per-minute mutation budget.

Live metrics for posts published through Social0 in the window. Metrics are fetched from each platform at request time; check `sampled` and `partial` before treating totals as complete.
Per-publication metrics for a single Social0 post, across every network it went out on.
